name: Noise Complaints
summary: Knaz Blunderflame asks you to drive off Mosh'Ogg ogres drawn by Gnaz's noisy tinkering. Knaz fears the ogres will maul them over Gnaz's Mirage Raceway dream.

sections.title: Ogres Nearby
sections.body: Gnaz has been tinkering late into the night on a contraption for the Mirage Raceway Championships in Kalimdor. Knaz warned him about the noise after spotting an ogre peeking from behind a tree. Now Knaz sends you north over the hill to stop the Mosh'Ogg ogres at Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount before they attack.

faq.answer: Knaz Blunderflame asks you to stop the Mosh'Ogg ogres snooping near their camp.
Knaz saw an ogre peeking from behind a tree after Gnaz's noisy late-night tinkering drew their attention.
It is Gnaz, not Knaz, who is building a contraption for the Mirage Raceway Championships.
The Mosh'Ogg ogres are near Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
It is Knaz who is bothered by Gnaz's noisy late-night tinkering, fearing the ogres will maul them.
